dedupe_keys.name: gis dataset for landslide susceptibility maps

description: The CRESCO Adria-Climate Resilient Coastal Planning project publishes landslide susceptibility maps for its Nuova Pescara pilot area, covering Pescara, Montesilvano and Spoltore in Italy. Zenodo lists a public ZIP under CC BY 4.0 at no cost and identifies it as project deliverable D.1.4.1. The map can be a regional hazard input when screening roads, utilities or buildings for landslide exposure. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this pilot release. The landing page does not give the archive’s internal GIS format, resolution, scenario date or susceptibility legend. Those properties require checking the files before a numerical simulation or comparison with other mapped hazards. The deposit describes susceptibility, not observed slope failure or a site investigation. No ZIP was downloaded, and the map’s georeferencing, classes and completeness were not independently checked.
